prerequisites: Graduation exercises which the student draws, animates and measures electronic circuits.
Record of measurements and their evaluation in the workbook
Oral examination according to the basic topics of lectures

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge on the transmission of signals over metallic and fiber-optic lines.
Practical design of electronic circuits for measurement.
Diagnosis of rotating machinery from measurements of angular velocity.

syllabus_topics: Lab work, tools and equipment for electronics. Measurement of line parameters, coaxial, pair, twisted, Zo, attenuation, reflections. Determining the interfering signal transmission components
Assembly and testing of the pulse generator.
Measurement of static and dynamic characteristics of the optocoupler.
Measurements on Fibre-optics and its end converters, transmission, impact deformation
Assembly and testing of the current converter
Assembly and testing of the reference or power source.
